title: C3X Explanation Implementation I3 — License-Bearing Retrieval, Typed Evidence-Graph Merge, Multi-Axis Commentary Evaluation & Human-Utility Readiness
implemented: license/source-bearing retrieval records with rejection of unlicensed or oversized entries
retrieval packets ranked by explicit motif/concept/category tag overlap
retrieval references remain CONVENTIONAL_HEURISTIC_COMMENTARY and cannot promote causal authority
typed per-moment explanation subgraphs linking evidence atoms to played moves and provenance objects
multi-axis commentary evaluation packet spanning structural, motif, tactic, position judgment, semantic, contrastiveness and provenance evidence
human-utility fields remain explicitly unset until human adjudication
CLI support for retrieval indexes and bounded top-k retrieval
scientific_firewall: retrieved human commentary is reference evidence only
typed graph structure cannot upgrade evidence authority
only C3X_CAUSAL_CONTRAST certificates authorize causal engine-preference wording
Track B code/CI cannot modify Track A P18 outcomes
next: I4 should connect C3X causal certificates as first-class graph objects, add verified line-backed planning/threat adapters, retrieval corpus governance, and a renderer benchmark against ACT-Eval-style atomic factuality before any free-form LLM prose is promoted.
